title: Tanker report - Week 47
summary:
Clean
LR2
LR2 performance was mixed this week, with a sharp rise in eastbound Middle East Gulf rates contrasting with softer westbound and Mediterranean routes. TC1 (75kt MEG/Japan) climbed 36 points to WS1049, lifting the Baltic round-trip TCE by $11,400 to $308,200/day. Conversely, TC20 (90kt MEG/UK-Continent) eased by $378,600 to $18.64 million, corresponding to a Baltic round-trip TCE of $287,600/day.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: VLCC rates on the Baltic Exchange strengthened across most routes this week. TD3C (270,000 mt Middle East Gulf/China) rose 21.25 points to WS315.63, generating a daily round-trip TCE of $1,079,794 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: The Suezmax market firmed broadly across the Baltic Exchange routes this week. The 130,000 mt Nigeria/UK Continent route (TD20) advanced 22.56 points to WS330.56, equating to a daily round-trip TCE of approximately $165,677.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: The Aframax market strengthened sharply this week, with exceptional gains across the Atlantic routes accompanied by firming in the North Sea and Mediterranean, while Vancouver exports were comparatively subdued. In the North Sea, the 80,000 mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) advanced 40.83 points to WS288.33, equating to a daily round-trip TCE of just under $183,937, basis Hound Point/Wilhelmshaven.
